title: Interpretable Debiasing of Vision-Language Models for Social Fairness

bias_targets.methodology: Measured using Max Skew to quantify the uniformity of retrieved images across genders for neutral text prompts (T2I retrieval), gender disproportion rate in VQA model answers, and accuracy on gender-bias benchmarks like VLAGenderBias and SBBench.
Measured using Max Skew to quantify the uniformity of retrieved images across racial groups (defined by the FairFace dataset) for neutral prompts and through intersectional bias analysis.
Measured using Max Skew to quantify the uniformity of retrieved images across age groups (defined by the FairFace dataset) and accuracy on the SBBench age category.
